page.layout: One page of running text, one column. Printed page number and running head at the top. Two marginal notes on the right: "Pearf. p. 59. 60." beside the first lines, and "in lib. I. Const. Apost. p. 117." beside the middle lines.

main_text.l: lasij Decretum conatus plane irritos fuis-
se; stat enim utrinque sarta, tecta & firma
autoritas, quam praestantissimus Vindicia-
rum Autor nequaquam covellere potuit,
quamvis eam maxima cum impetu ador-
tus sit, illamque undique follicitare ten-
taverit: nec Viri docti causam juvat
quod postremo dicit, Ignatij Epistolas in
Nicephori Indiculo, nec nominari, nec
innui, nec quovis modo contineri, sed
Ignatij [illegible, ~5 letters] seu [illegible,
~9 letters], id est do-ctrinam quam omnes apocrypham & spu-
riam fatentur, ut hoc probet, ad Indicu-
lum confugit MS. qui extat inter libros
Baroccianos in Bibliotheca publica Oxo-
nij, in quo liber ille qui Ignatij doctrina
inscribitur inter apocrypha relegatur; si-
milem Indiculum, ex Bibliotheca Chri-
stianissimi Regis edidit Ioannes Baptista
Cotelerius, ex quo quemadmodum ex suo
MS. Vindiciarum Autor, colligit Later-
culum Nicephorianum non amandare ad
apocrypha Epistolas Ignatij, sed librum
illum qui Ignatij doctrina cognominatur;
quid audio, Nicephorus Ignatiana abs-
que ulla distinctione in apocryphorum
ordine ac classe censet, Viri autem isti
eruditi ad Ignatij [illegible, ~6 letters] referunt, quae
Patriarcha Constatinopolitanus de Ign-
atianis in genere pronuntiavit; De Herma

marginalia.note: in lib. I. Const. Apost. p. 117.

page.notes: Greek words after "Ignatij" and "seu" are printed in Greek letters but are too small and worn to read reliably; marked illegible. The printed word at the end of the last line is "Hermâ" (the mark after it is a stray printer's or scan mark, not text). A small dot in the lower part of the page and speckles are scan dirt and were left out. The first word "lasij" is partly cut off at the left edge and may be a fragment. No catchword or signature is printed.
